s20_boot2.py.note: The axis-complete inference surface: a nested moving-block bootstrap refitting the whole pipeline inside every draw, over a grid declared before the first draw by a rule reading only a log's row count. The files on disk are the 19-pair run of 24 August 2026, 150 draws on the primary log and 40-80 elsewhere, written per pair under results/s20/.

s21_bands.py.note: round twenty-three: line endings normalised only; the computation and its outputs are unchanged, and the two critical-value estimates it has always written are now compared by s40_qcheck

s22_anova.py.note: The corrected functional-ANOVA decomposition: every disjoint component computed, the total higher-order share as 1 - sum of first-order indices, under four declared measures, with the duplicate-level and grid-refinement invariances executed rather than asserted.

s23_regret.py.note: Specification regret on a coherent scale: design A metric-specific, design B on calibrated net benefit, design C over five monotone utility maps, with the four decision rules compared out of sample on held-out cells, held-out time and held-out logs.

s24_confirm.py.note: The five final-round planned contrasts PC1-PC5 at 2,000 independent draws, with plus-one p-values and a Holm step-down. Relabelled from C1-C5 because that collided with the correction register's identifiers.

s25_denominator.py.note: round twenty-two: the declared surface carries the pipelines the inference surface uses, and everything that reads it was recomputed

s26_calib_dca.py.note: Training-only calibration before any decision curve, with the calibrator rebuilt inside every bootstrap refit, and a simultaneous band over the whole net-benefit family. The band file declares its interval construction, which is basic for both the pointwise and the simultaneous pair.

s27_quality.py.note: Register-quality severity curves over 11 levels and 20 seeds, including the three dependent mechanisms - time, content and a training-estimated propensity - each verified train-only by execution.

s28_figures.py.note: round twenty-three: the sensitivity figure no longer clips bars that exceed one, and marks one with a rule; figures regenerated

s29_props.py.note: The propositions at their stated scope: the non-identification construction, the affine-invariance certificates, and the non-rank-based instrument whose reduction is invariant.

s30_pilot_var.py.note: Design-based linearised and stratified-bootstrap variance for the pilot's two-stratum ratio estimator, replacing the Wilson intervals built on a fractional effective sample.

s31_simboost.py.note: The simulation at the size the review requires: 1,000 replicates in each of six worlds at 100 nested refits each, a ten-cell (n,K) plane to K=3,019, three block lengths around n^(1/3), and seven interval constructions including m-out-of-n at m=n^(2/3). The core and block experiments ran 24 August 2026 as --only core,block; the grid ran as --resume, which also re-summarised all three with the experiment-aware key. Imports the world generator and the enumerated truth from s10 rather than copying them.
